high_level_description: A wide cinematic 1216x832 anime illustration in Akira Toriyama style for a tech blog header. A chibi Wojtek stands next to a stone server pedestal on which a sturdy chrome dumbbell sits, holding up a large golden house key with both hands like a trophy. Green checkmark badges are arranged around the dumbbell. Behind them, on the floor, a dark cracked monitor lies with its cable unplugged and screen black. Represents resurrecting an offline agent session and deploying a self-hosted gym tracker protected by passkeys. No extraneous banner text across the bottom of the image.

style_description.aesthetics: Akira Toriyama anime style, Dragon Ball cel-shaded cartoon, bold black outlines, triumphant workshop scene, clean blog illustration
style_description.lighting: warm workshop lamps from above, golden light bouncing off the big key, cool dim corner behind the dark monitor
style_description.medium: digital anime illustration, flat cel colors with subtle gradients, bold ink outlines, technology blog art
style_description.art_style: cel-shaded anime illustration in the style of Akira Toriyama, rounded exaggerated proportions, clean flat coloring, bold ink outlines

compositional_deconstruction.background: A cozy homelab workshop interior filling the entire canvas edge to edge with content from the very top edge to the very bottom edge, no empty space. Wooden workbench along the back wall with tools, hanging lamp cones above, a striped wallpaper pattern, warm brown floorboards.

elements.desc: Full-frame homelab workshop interior: workbench with tools along the back wall, hanging lamps above, warm floorboards, a square rack of small green indicator lights built into the left wall, filling the frame from top edge to bottom edge.

A friendly adult man named Wojtek drawn in Toriyama chibi style, long straight medium-brown hair reaching below his shoulders parted near the center, a full dark-brown beard and mustache, clear rectangular eyeglasses, warm light skin, broad friendly smile. He wears an oversized casual dark t-shirt and dark wide-leg trousers. He stands upright holding a large ornate golden key with both hands raised in front of his chest.
A short stone pedestal to the right on which sits a sturdy chrome dumbbell with red weight plates, three round green checkmark badges stacked neatly beside its base.

In the lower left corner a dark old computer monitor tipped over on the floor, screen black with one visible crack line, its power cable lying loose and unplugged beside it, a small dust puff drawn on its frame.
